tutorial.name: First Contact
tutorial.description: A guided first match. Learn energy, characters, combat, Taunt, Deathrattle, spells, locations, and Charge by playing them.

steps.title: Energy and your hand
steps.text: You start with 1 energy. Cards cost energy to play. Click Squire (cost 1) in your hand, then Play Card.

steps.title: Exhausted characters
steps.text: Most characters cannot attack the turn they are played. Click End Turn and let the Recruiter go. Charge is the exception — those can attack immediately.

steps.title: Combat
steps.text: Your character is ready. Click it on your board, then click the highlighted enemy. If nothing is blocking you, click Attack Face instead.

steps.title: Deathrattle
steps.text: Hatchling Brood died and summoned a Raptor. Deathrattle happens when a character dies — you still have to deal with the new body.

steps.title: Taunt
steps.text: That enemy has Taunt — you must attack it first. Click your ready character, then click the outlined Taunt character. You cannot hit face until the wall is gone.

steps.title: Spells
steps.text: Spells are one-shot effects. Click Divine Smite, then click the highlighted enemy you want to damage.

steps.title: Locations
steps.text: Locations stay in play (one at a time). Play Sacred Chapel — it appears in your location slot and heals your characters each turn.

steps.title: Charge
steps.text: Zealot has Charge — it can attack the turn you play it. Click Zealot, Play Card, then attack with it immediately.

steps.title: Your move
steps.text: You know the loop: spend energy, attack, end turn. Reduce the Recruiter to 0 life. The Recruiter will keep poking your hero, so do not stall.

keyword_lab.name: Keyword Lab
keyword_lab.description: A skippable drill. Recycle, Split, Drain, and Ward one at a time on a live board.

steps.title: Recycle
steps.text: Burn Bag has Recycle. Select it, then click Recycle — pay 1 energy, shuffle it into your deck, and draw. You are not playing it.

steps.title: Split
steps.text: Play Forked Brief. Split lets you pick one printed option. Deal 2 damage to the highlighted Hatchling — killing it is better than drawing here.

steps.title: Drain
steps.text: Play Leech Contact. Drain heals your hero for the combat damage it deals. Next turn, attack with it.

steps.title: Drain combat
steps.text: Leech Contact is ready. Attack face or a character — the damage heals you. That is Drain.

steps.title: Ward
steps.text: Play Quiet Vest. Ward ignores all damage until the end of this turn and does not pop. It fades when your turn ends.

steps.title: Lab complete
steps.text: Recycle, Split, Drain, and Ward are the new verbs. Finish the Instructor or return to the menu whenever you like.

showcase_illuminati.name: Shadow Council
showcase_illuminati.description: Play the Illuminati control list against a Templar defense. Deny resources, then close the game.

showcase_templars.name: Holy Host
showcase_templars.description: Play the Templar defense list against a Reptilian rush. Taunt, heal, and outlast the swarm.

showcase_reptilians.name: Invasion Force
showcase_reptilians.description: Play the Reptilian aggro list against Illuminati control. Hit hard before they lock the board.
